standard_prerequisites.name: Sectionwise description of extension by zero and exactness of sheafification

standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the explicit description of the presheaf map used in the left-exactness argument.

core_obligations: Obtain right exactness from the adjunction: j_{U!} is left adjoint to j_U^*, hence preserves colimits and in particular is right exact (proof lines 2392-2396).

For left exactness, let G_1 -> G_2 be an injective map of modules on U and describe the induced map of underlying presheaves over an object V as the direct sum over Mor(V, U) of the given injective maps, hence an injection (proof lines 2397-2405).
Conclude that j_{U!}G_1 -> j_{U!}G_2 is injective because sheafification is exact, so j_{U!} is exact, completing the proof up to line 2407 (proof lines 2405-2407).
proof_roadmap: Describe the presheaf map sectionwise as a direct sum of injections.
Use exactness of sheafification to conclude left exactness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves exactness of the functor j_{U!} taking a module on an object U to a module on the whole ringed site. Right exactness follows from the adjunction, since j_{U!} is a left adjoint to j_U^*. Left exactness is checked on an injective map: the induced map of the underlying presheaves has sections over an object V given by a direct sum, over the morphisms V -> U, of the original injective maps, hence is injective objectwise, and sheafification preserves this injectivity because it is exact (proof lines 2392-2407). H2: the sectionwise description of the presheaf map and the use of exactness of sheafification are the substance.
